Name: Face Details (for male farmer) - a FashionSense pack
Author: acekidprod
Description:
[size=4][b]This is a content pack for Fashion Sense. [/b]The eye elements all look better with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17220]No Blink[/url] installed.[/size]

[size=4][b][u]>>> This pack is made for the male farmer model ONLY !![/u][/b][/size]
[size=4]Technically nothing is stopping you from using it with the female farmer, but it will look wonky during animations.[/size]
[size=4]I'm very sorry it took so much time to make I don't have any motivation to adapt to the female farmer model. But if you want to adapt it yourself, feel free as long as you credit me! I tried to make the JSON files as easy to understand as possible.[/size]
[size=4]Also I didn't find a way to sync the accessories to the farmer's face when riding the horse, if you know how to correctly do that, let me know![/size]

[size=4]It contains:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Eye shines (4 variants)[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Blushes (3 variants)[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Nose (1 variant)[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Eyebrows (4 variants)[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Glasses (2 variants)[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]You can use multiple of them at the same time, as FashionSense allows for a big number of accessories at the same time with the small arrows under the farmer frame.[/size]

[size=4]The hairstyles in the screenshots are from my other mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43746]Play as Xie Lian[/url].[/size]

Manifest.Name: (FS) Face Details (for male farmer)
Manifest.Description: Adds face details as accessories for Fashion Sense (for male farmer only)
